Polymer approaches IBC not as a monolithic protocol, but as a modular execution stack. With vIBC, the IBC transport layer is decoupled from chains and outsourced to Polymer Hub. @Polymer_Labs
In Polymer’s vIBC model, the application and verification layers stay on the chain, while IBC execution and transport run on Polymer. This separation unlocks real scalability.
Chains that outsource IBC execution to Polymer are modeled as virtual chains. In the IBC topology, they appear as real hops and can later upgrade to native IBC seamlessly.
Polymer deploys a vIBC core smart contract on connected chains. This contract exposes IBC channel and packet lifecycles through a standardized API for applications.

ZK-Rollups: Assume Invalid, Prove Valid
